name: walk_umbrella
text: A person walks steadily forward holding an umbrella upright close to the right shoulder. The right hand grips the vertical pole in front of the shoulder at upper chest height, and the left arm swings freely.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右手稳定在右肩前持伞，左手收在腹前；首版右手过度外伸，改为参考耳侧持物手位向下20厘米、向前15厘米的末端约束，再用全身关键帧生成循环。
